description: Controlled Aqlyra retrieval corpus with semantic paraphrases and exact identifier questions.

cases.query: Which month is the yearly security assessment scheduled?
cases.evidence_marker: The annual security review happens every October.

cases.query: What is the emergency credential reference code?
cases.evidence_marker: The emergency credential reference is ZX-41-LANTERN.

cases.query: How long must incident records be kept?
cases.evidence_marker: Incident records are retained for seven years.

cases.query: What is the acknowledgement deadline for a severity-one incident?
cases.evidence_marker: A severity-one incident must be acknowledged within 15 minutes.

cases.query: At what UTC time does the nightly vector backup begin?
cases.evidence_marker: The nightly vector backup starts at 02:30 UTC.

cases.query: How long does a retrieval cache entry remain valid?
cases.evidence_marker: The retrieval cache has an 18-minute TTL.

cases.query: How many samples were used in experiment ORBIT-73?
cases.evidence_marker: Experiment ORBIT-73 used 1,200 samples.

cases.query: What fraction of the dataset was reserved for validation?
cases.evidence_marker: The validation split was 18 percent of the dataset.

cases.query: After how many minutes is a priority-one support case escalated?
cases.evidence_marker: A priority-one support case is escalated after 12 minutes.

cases.query: How many independent identity signals are required for account recovery?
cases.evidence_marker: Account recovery requires two independent identity signals.

cases.query: What is the completion deadline for an approved data export request?
cases.evidence_marker: Approved data export requests must be completed within 21 days.

cases.query: For how many days are privacy audit logs retained?
cases.evidence_marker: Privacy audit logs are retained for 400 days.

cases.query: What percentage of traffic does a production canary receive initially?
cases.evidence_marker: A production canary begins with 5 percent of traffic.

cases.query: What error-rate condition automatically triggers rollback?
cases.evidence_marker: Rollback is triggered when the error rate exceeds 2.5 percent for three consecutive minutes.

cases.query: How many approvers are needed for a vendor invoice above 25,000 dollars?
cases.evidence_marker: Vendor invoices above 25,000 dollars require two approvers.

cases.query: On which business day does the monthly accounting close become locked?
cases.evidence_marker: The monthly accounting close locks on the fourth business day.

cases.query: What is the registry label for the restricted dataset?
cases.evidence_marker: The restricted dataset registry label is DV-88-PINE.

cases.query: When is raw telemetry deleted?
cases.evidence_marker: Raw telemetry is deleted after 45 days.

cases.query: What is the documented recovery time objective?
cases.evidence_marker: The recovery time objective is 90 minutes.

cases.query: When are the scheduled failover tests performed?
cases.evidence_marker: The scheduled failover test runs on the first Tuesday of March and September.
